description: Na₂Ca₂(CO₃)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Amm2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ca is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.57 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.28 Å) and two longer (1.29 Å) C-O bond lengths. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.28 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ca, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, two equivalent Ca, and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₂Ca₂C trigonal bipyramids.
